Where bettors who already win scale up. PRO Odds Screen surfaces every +EV play across 200+ books — sort by edge, hit lines before they move, and get more volume down across every account you run.

Hang sharper prices. Detect line moves before competitors. Tighten margins at scale. Real-time True Line and steam alerts piped into your trading workflow — props, SGPs, alts, and main markets, all priced from one engine.

Each book weighted by sport, market, and prop type based on historical sharpness. Pinnacle's NBA spread isn't the same signal as their NFL alts.

Sharp early action, steam moves, and reverse line movement all factored into how confidently each price gets set.

Player props, alts, and exotic markets carry structural biases the sides-and-totals world doesn't. We adjust per prop type.
